scenario: the first practical exchange about neighbourhood & directions
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Neighbourhood and Directions
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: neighbourhood & directions — the first practical exchange about neighbourhood & directions
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about neighbourhood & directions; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Michael where the train station is.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Michael ga tàu ở đâu.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Michael. Where is the train station?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh Michael. Ga tàu ở đâu vậy?

turns.speaker: Mr Michael
turns.english: It is two blocks from here.
turns.vietnamese: Nó cách đây hai dãy nhà.
